已知有界区域 $\Omega$ 由曲面 $z=\sqrt{4-x^2-y^2}$ 与 $z=\sqrt{x^2+y^2}$ 围成，函数 $f(u)$ 连续，则
\[\iiint_{\Omega} f(x^2+y^2+z^2)\,\mathrm{d}x\,\mathrm{d}y\,\mathrm{d}z = \quad (\quad)\]
A. \[\int_0^{2\pi} \mathrm{d}\theta \int_0^2 \mathrm{d}r \int_r^{\sqrt{4-r^2}} f(r^2+z^2) r \,\mathrm{d}z\]
B. \[\int_0^{2\pi} \mathrm{d}\theta \int_0^{\sqrt{2}} \mathrm{d}r \int_0^{\sqrt{4-r^2}} f(r^2+z^2) r \,\mathrm{d}z\]
C. \[\int_0^{2\pi} \mathrm{d}\theta \int_0^{\frac{\pi}{4}} \mathrm{d}\varphi \int_0^2 f(r^2) r^2 \sin\varphi \,\mathrm{d}r\]
D. \[\int_0^{2\pi} \mathrm{d}\theta \int_0^{\frac{\pi}{2}} \mathrm{d}\varphi \int_0^2 f(r^2) r^2 \sin\varphi \,\mathrm{d}r\]
